summary.headline: Modena Codex: Astronomy and Astrology
summary.text: Catalog entries for a Modena astrological codex covering solar motion, planetary phases and stations, zodiacal scholia, solar and lunar eclipses, solstices, an astronomical calendar attributed to Antiochus, calends, the rising of the Dog, Orpheus on earthquakes, Pythagorean calculations, epigrams from the Anthology, and Paul of Alexandria’s exposition of the twelve zodiac signs.
